name: CodeStick
highlight: Offline AI on USB | Plug & Play
description: A tool that puts an offline AI coding assistant onto a standard USB drive. Plug it into any laptop, run AI locally without internet, and unplug it leaving zero files behind.

sections.title: Runs Anywhere from USB
sections.content: Detects the connected USB drive and installs pre-packaged AI tools so the assistant is ready to boot on any computer immediately.

sections.title: Zero Traces Left Behind
sections.content: Keeps all files, chat history, and AI models strictly inside the USB drive. When you unplug it, no data is left on the computer.

sections.title: Fast Setup
sections.content: Includes a quick installer that verifies file safety and copies files efficiently even on low-cost USB drives.

learnings: Running AI off a USB drive solves major privacy and data security concerns for developers in secure environments.
Keeping data 100% local builds high trust with users who care about data privacy.

name: Portable AI
description: A CLI tool that turns any standard USB drive into a portable AI workstation featuring local models and a clean chat interface.

sections.title: Dual-OS Storage
sections.content: Shares model files and chat history cleanly between Windows and Mac laptops using a single USB drive.

sections.title: One-Click Launchers
sections.content: Includes simple double-click launch scripts that start the AI server without requiring any software installation on the computer.

sections.title: Reliable Downloads
sections.content: Built-in download manager that safely downloads large AI models even if the internet disconnects.

learnings: Standardizing USB drive formats makes portable tools reliable across both Mac and Windows.
Decoupling the AI model from the host computer gives users complete control over their data.

name: MCPProbe
highlight: Diagnostic Tool for AI Tools & MCP
description: A diagnostic scanner for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Instantly checks server health, tests client compatibility, and generates working configs.

sections.title: Server Health Checks
sections.content: Connects to MCP servers to inspect available tools, parameters, and prompts, giving developers a clear view of server health.

sections.title: Compatibility Testing
sections.content: Tests MCP tools against popular AI editors (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code) to make sure they work everywhere without errors.

sections.title: Automatic Configuration
sections.content: Generates ready-to-use JSON config files for AI editors so developers can add tools without typing manual config lines.

learnings: Giving developers a simple 0-100 health score helps them quickly fix broken AI tools.
Testing tools across multiple AI editors prevents hidden connection crashes.

name: Autonoma
description: An AI support assistant that automatically answers customer messages on WhatsApp, Discord, and Email. It remembers past conversations and resolves 85% of routine support requests.

sections.title: Live Support Dashboard
sections.content: A clean web dashboard that lets team members monitor AI conversations in real-time and jump in whenever needed.

sections.title: Smart Memory Search
sections.content: Remembers past customer details and past interactions so customers don't have to repeat themselves.

sections.title: Multi-Channel Messaging
sections.content: Connects WhatsApp, Discord, Email, and WebSockets into one central inbox for the AI bot.

learnings: Combining local search memory with AI models delivers faster and more accurate support replies.
Providing a live dashboard builds team confidence in AI customer service.

name: FerrumDB
description: A lightweight database engine built in Rust from scratch. It stores data with built-in encryption and instant lookup times.

sections.title: Fast Log-Based Storage
sections.content: Uses an append-only log format that guarantees high-speed data writes and instant crash recovery.

sections.title: Built-In Encryption
sections.content: Automatically encrypts stored data using AES-256 encryption so files remain safe on disk.

sections.title: Ferrum Studio Dashboard
sections.content: Includes an embedded web dashboard to inspect keys, monitor database health, and view live performance metrics.

learnings: Rust is an ideal language for building crash-safe, high-speed database engines.
Keeping data retrieval instant in memory while writing securely to disk is key for embedded storage.

name: CodeLens
description: An AI search tool that lets developers ask questions in plain English about any codebase. Used by 200+ engineers to find code and understand architecture fast.

sections.title: Smart Code Search
sections.content: Understands code structure and functions instead of just matching exact keywords, finding relevant logic instantly.

sections.title: Visual Code Explorer
sections.content: A clean interface that helps new engineers understand complex codebase architectures in minutes.

sections.title: Fast Code Scanning
sections.content: Only re-scans modified code files, keeping search index updates fast and low-cost.

learnings: Searching code by semantic intent is far more useful than simple keyword search for large repositories.
Parsing code by functions and classes produces much better AI search results.

name: Go Load Balancer
description: A high-speed HTTP load balancer built in Go. Distributes web traffic evenly across servers with health monitoring and zero downtime.

sections.title: Smart Traffic Routing
sections.content: Includes 5 routing strategies (Round-Robin, Least Connections, IP Hash) to balance server workloads evenly.

sections.title: Failing Server Protection
sections.content: Automatically stops sending traffic to unhealthy or crashing servers so users never see error screens.

sections.title: Live Server Monitoring
sections.content: Integrates Prometheus and Grafana dashboards for real-time traffic monitoring.

learnings: Go's lightweight goroutines make it excellent for high-concurrency web proxying.
Automatically isolating unhealthy servers prevents widespread website outages.

name: Echo AI Agent
description: A voice-enabled AI chat app with real-time visual animations and local speech recognition.

sections.title: Animated Voice HUD
sections.content: Features a responsive visual orb interface that reacts directly to the sound of your voice.

sections.title: Private Voice Processing
sections.content: Uses local Whisper speech recognition so voice commands can be processed offline.

sections.title: Computer Actions
sections.content: Enables the AI to execute terminal commands, open files, and perform tasks on your computer.

learnings: Visual animations make voice AI feel alive and engaging for users.
Sub-second voice detection is critical for natural voice conversations.

name: ELYX
highlight: Local-First AI Worker | Cuts Manual Tasks 70%
description: An AI worker assistant that monitors emails, messaging apps, and tasks to execute workflows with human review.

sections.title: Channel Monitor
sections.content: Monitors incoming emails and messages to automatically organize them into clear action items.

sections.title: Markdown Storage
sections.content: Stores all memory and plans in plain Markdown files inside an Obsidian vault so everything is readable.

sections.title: Human Review
sections.content: Requires human approval before sending important messages or taking major actions.

learnings: Requiring human approval for major actions builds trust in automated workflow tools.
Plain Markdown files make AI memory easy to audit and edit.

name: Promptly
description: An AI helper tool that gives AI coding assistants exact context about your codebase, stopping them from writing broken code or making false assumptions.

sections.title: Codebase Context Injection
sections.content: Maps your project structure and dependencies so AI coding tools write accurate, non-broken code.

sections.title: Agent-Specific Tuning
sections.content: Tunes prompt context specifically for your AI editor (Cursor, Claude, Gemini).

sections.title: Zero-Config Setup
sections.content: Simple CLI setup that configures MCP tool settings automatically.

learnings: Feeding exact codebase context into AI tools cuts code errors dramatically.
Keeping context lookup under 50ms makes the tool feel instantaneous.

name: Physical AI Platform
description: An interactive learning platform for robotics. Features an AI tutor grounded in ROS 2 concepts and instant Urdu translation.

sections.title: AI Robotics Tutor
sections.content: An AI tutor that answers student questions specifically about robotics and ROS 2 concepts.

sections.title: 13-Week Robotics Course
sections.content: Curated lessons taking students from basic ROS 2 setup to NVIDIA Isaac Sim robotics simulation.

sections.title: Personalized Learning
sections.content: Adjusts technical depth based on the student's background.

learnings: Grounding AI tutors in specific course content prevents wrong answers during technical learning.
Providing native language translation expands technical education accessibility.

name: Notion Autopilot
description: An AI agent that automatically scans, cleans up, and organizes messy Notion workspaces.

sections.title: Workspace Crawler
sections.content: Scans Notion pages to identify duplicate notes, broken links, and unorganized pages.

sections.title: Summary Insights
sections.content: Summarizes key ideas and recurring topics across scattered notes.

sections.title: Multi-Provider AI
sections.content: Supports both fast cloud AI (Groq/Gemini) and free local AI (Ollama).

learnings: Building a reliable Notion API crawler requires handling rate limits carefully.
Summarizing scattered notes provides huge productivity value to users.

name: OpsForge
highlight: DevOps CLI Toolkit Built in Go
description: A zero-dependency DevOps CLI toolkit built with Go's standard library for load testing, SSL checking, and network scanning.

sections.title: Zero External Dependencies
sections.content: Built strictly using Go's standard library, resulting in small binaries and zero third-party vulnerability risks.

sections.title: Fast Parallel Scans
sections.content: Uses Go goroutines to scan thousands of ports and endpoints concurrently.

sections.title: CLI & REST API Modes
sections.content: Can be run as a terminal command or as a lightweight REST API server.

learnings: Building tools with zero external dependencies creates clean, maintainable software.
Go standard library is powerful enough to handle complex CLI and networking tools.

name: Automation Vault
description: A collection of production workflows built in n8n that automate software review, documentation updates, and customer leads.

sections.title: AI Code Review Workflow
sections.content: Intercepts GitHub PRs, performs automated AI code reviews, and sends summary alerts to Slack.

sections.title: Automated Docs Generator
sections.content: Scans README files for missing details and generates automated documentation PRs.

sections.title: AI Lead Qualifier
sections.content: Qualifies incoming leads using fast AI models and sends personalized email follow-ups.

learnings: Proper error handling and retries are essential for reliable production workflows.
Event-driven automation saves engineering teams dozens of hours each week.

name: THE SIGNAL
description: An automated AI newsletter generator that crawls global tech news and sends weekly high-signal briefings to subscribers.

sections.title: Automated News Scraper
sections.content: Crawls tech news and trending GitHub repositories, using Gemini 2.0 to summarize key updates.

sections.title: Scheduled Email Dispatch
sections.content: Uses background job schedulers to deliver newsletters across global subscriber timezones automatically.

sections.title: Subscriber Progression
sections.content: Unlocks custom UI themes as subscribers read more weekly issues.

learnings: Automating content collection and delivery creates a hands-off, valuable newsletter product.
Background job queues make scheduled dispatches reliable.

name: todo-audit
highlight: Fast Technical Debt Auditor in Rust
description: A fast CLI tool written in Rust that scans codebases to audit and report TODO and FIXME annotations with Git-blame details.

sections.title: Fast Codebase Scanner
sections.content: Scans code files instantly for TODO, FIXME, and HACK markers while respecting .gitignore rules.

sections.title: Lazy Git Info Fetch
sections.content: Only fetches author and date commit details when requested, keeping scanning speeds high.

sections.title: CI/CD Pipeline Gate
sections.content: Can be run inside GitHub Actions to block PRs if technical debt exceeds limits.

learnings: CLI tools must scan instantly to be adopted by engineering teams.
Lazy-loading expensive metadata like Git blame keeps scanning ultra-fast.

name: VidX
description: An easy terminal CLI that simplifies FFmpeg into guided commands for compressing and converting web videos.

sections.title: Simple Video Presets
sections.content: Replaces complex FFmpeg terminal commands with simple 'Web Optimized' and 'High Quality' choices.

sections.title: GIF-to-MP4 Converter
sections.content: Converts heavy .gif files into small, looping MP4 videos, cutting asset sizes by over 90%.

sections.title: Automatic Setup
sections.content: Detects installed FFmpeg binaries on Mac, Windows, and Linux automatically.

learnings: Wrapping complex command-line tools like FFmpeg in interactive menus makes them dramatically more useful.
Converting heavy GIFs to web MP4s provides massive page load speedups.
